name: Score and enrich target accounts from Google Sheets with Glasser, Claude, Slack and Gmail

parameters.content:
# Score and enrich target accounts from Google Sheets with Glasser, Claude, Slack and Gmail

## Who it's for
Sales, SDR and RevOps teams who keep a list of target companies in a Google Sheet and want each one researched, scored against their ideal customer profile and turned into a ready-to-send opener, without a rep doing the digging.

## How it works
1. Every morning (or on demand) the workflow reads the rows in your **Accounts** sheet that have no `Status` yet.
2. For each domain, four Glasser calls run in parallel: company profile, technology stack, recent news and funding rounds. Glasser picks the data provider (Apollo, BuiltWith, PredictLeads) and reports which one answered.
3. Claude scores the account from 1 to 10 against the ideal customer profile you wrote in **Describe your ideal customer**, names the strongest buying signal and the job titles worth contacting.
4. Accounts that score 6 or more get decision makers from Glasser (People Data Labs), each work email is verified with Glasser's email finder (Hunter), and Claude drafts a three-sentence opener.
5. Every row is written back to the sheet with score, reason, signal, contacts and opener, so nothing is researched twice.
6. Scores of 8 to 10 post to your hot-leads Slack channel and become a Gmail draft addressed to the top contact; 6 to 7 go to a warm-leads channel; below 6 is only logged. A summary is posted when the run ends.

## How to set up
1. Install the verified **Glasser** community node from the nodes panel. Create a Key at [app.glasser.ai/keys](https://app.glasser.ai/keys) and add it as a **Glasser API** credential on the seven Glasser nodes.
2. Make a copy of the [Accounts sheet template](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/10V-7jXRYIMVsNAeUKMKmmgMrHl2wh_C4f9qTjXoTOaA/copy), add your target domains in column A, and paste its spreadsheet ID into the three Google Sheets nodes.
3. Add your Anthropic API key in **Claude** (or swap in another chat model).
4. Write your ideal customer profile in **Describe your ideal customer**.
5. Connect Slack and set the two channel names in **Alert hot lead** and **Alert warm lead**; connect Gmail in **Draft the first email**.
6. Run it once with **Execute workflow**, then activate it for the daily schedule.

## Requirements
- A Glasser account with balance. Expect 10 to 20 cents per hot account and about half of that for a cold one, because people and email lookups only run for accounts that score 6 or more.
- An Anthropic API key, Google Sheets, Slack and Gmail.

## How to customize the workflow
- Change the thresholds in **Worth pursuing?** and **Route by score**.
- Add Glasser's website traffic, competitors or SEO operations to the research step.
- Replace Slack with Microsoft Teams, and the Gmail draft with HubSpot or Instantly.
- Raise the number of contacts per account in **Pick the top contacts**.

## 1. Read the accounts and loop
Runs daily or on demand, keeps only rows without a `Status`, attaches your ideal customer profile to each row and processes the accounts one at a time.

## 2. Research the company and score it
Four Glasser operations run in parallel on one credential. A Code node folds the raw provider responses into a short brief, and Claude returns a structured score, reason, buying signal and target job titles.

## 3. Find the people and write the opener
Only accounts scoring 6 or more get here. Glasser finds decision makers by title (People Data Labs), falls back to senior people by level when the titles miss, verifies each work email (Hunter), and Claude drafts a three-sentence opener from the brief and the buying signal.

## 4. Write back and alert
Every account is saved to the sheet so it is never researched twice. Hot accounts go to Slack and become a Gmail draft addressed to the top contact; warm ones go to a second channel. A summary posts when the loop ends.
